accessModel.title: Access model
accessModel.explanation: Objects are never publicly readable. Every upload uses a signed, expiring URL and every download is served through a short-lived signed URL (presigned S3 GET, or a signed proxy link for the local driver). There is no public bucket and no permanent public file URL.

coreCallout.title: Core features work with no external setup.
coreCallout.body: The directory, campaigns, content, reports and the <emphasis>influencer CSV/JSON export</emphasis> all run out of the box. Everything below is <emphasis>optional</emphasis> — each key upgrades one social platform from manual entry to automatic fetching. You're currently auto-fetching {active} of {total} platforms.

setup.storageBody: Two drivers, chosen with : local (default, disk, no keys) or s3 for S3/MinIO. Selecting s3 requires , , and (the server refuses to start otherwise).

YOUTUBE.headline: Turnkey — recommended first
YOUTUBE.unlocks: Auto-fetch channel stats and video metrics (views / likes / comments), on add and on every scheduled refresh.
steps: Google Cloud Console → create or select a project.
APIs & Services → Credentials → create an API key, restricted to the YouTube Data API.
Paste it below as YOUTUBE_API_KEY (or set the env var and restart).

X.headline: Key only — plan-dependent
X.unlocks: Auto-fetch profile public metrics and tweet metrics, subject to your API access tier.
steps: X Developer Portal → your project/app → generate a Bearer Token (App-only auth).
X.limitation: The free tier is very limited; a 403 from X surfaces as “requires app authorization”.

INSTAGRAM.headline: Profile + post likes/comments — Business/Creator accounts only
INSTAGRAM.unlocks: Auto-fetch profile (name, avatar, bio, followers) plus per-post likes, comments and Reel views for Professional target accounts' recent posts, via Business Discovery.
steps: Connect an Instagram Business/Creator account to a Facebook Page you own.
Meta for Developers → create an app → Instagram → “API setup with Facebook login” (NOT Instagram login).

Generate a long-lived token with instagram_basic, instagram_manage_insights, pages_read_engagement and pages_show_list — extend it to long-lived BEFORE calling /me/accounts, or the Page token inherits the short expiry.
Find your connected IG Business account id. BOTH values are required — with only one, it stays inactive.
INSTAGRAM.limitation: Use the “API setup with Facebook login” path — Business Discovery does not exist on the Instagram login path. Only recent posts of Professional accounts resolve; older posts and personal accounts stay manual. Views cover Reels only.

TIKTOK.headline: Embed + availability only
TIKTOK.unlocks: Public video embed and an availability check work with no keys. Statistics require Creator connections (below).
steps: For creator video stats, set up Creator connections (see the section below).

SNAPCHAT.headline: Manual
SNAPCHAT.unlocks: No public profile/content API. Snapchat is URL/manual-based; availability is a best-effort link check only.
steps: Nothing to configure — data is entered manually.

keyNotes.instagramBusinessAccountId: the “self” account the lookup runs through

setup.footerNote: Enter any provider key encrypted at rest from the Integrations screen (admin) — no restart needed — or set the environment variable and restart.

creatorConnections.intro: The only lawful way to read a specific creator's post/video metrics is for that creator to authorize the app, and for the app to pass the platform's review (Meta / TikTok). The flow is wired end to end but stays inert — it says “not configured” rather than pretending — until you complete review and set the app keys.
creatorConnections.step1: Create the Meta / TikTok app and complete app review for the insight scopes.
creatorConnections.outro: Then a creator connects from their profile page (Creator connections card). This is a platform constraint (app review), not a code gap.

verify.body: After adding a key, the platform card above flips to Auto-fetch active. To prove the fetch path, add an influencer from a real profile URL — a result marked Official API (not Manual) with real numbers confirms it. The Integrations screen also has a per-platform “test connection”.
